info.title: CommitVault API
info.description:
REST API of CommitVault, a personal workspace for recording commits, deployments, environments, releases and technical notes.

All endpoints except `/health`, `/auth/csrf`, `/auth/login` and `/auth/logout` require the session cookie. Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE request must also send the session's CSRF token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

get.description:
Returns the CSRF token bound to the current session, creating an anonymous
session if there is none. Required before the first state-changing request
(including login).

post.description: Invalidates the server-side session and clears the cookie.
Revokes every other session of the account.

deployments, releases and project notes.

from an environment, nor that one environment is ahead of or behind another.

Filter on *recorded* deployments. `none` means "no deployment record
